rationale: The stock has already gapped up ~6.7% on strong earnings and is trading at 81.6% of today's range near the session high, with the last candle showing a pullback from the intraday high of $69.54 — momentum is stalling at resistance. The broad market is under pressure (SPY -1.35%, VIXY +7.47%), which creates headwinds for chasing a gap-up name this late in its move. Risk/reward for both a long (limited upside to high, wide spread) and a short (strong fundamental catalyst still in play) is unfavorable at this moment.
